scenes.title: 1989 Stanford 4-Card Table: Same 'Cassava Root & Tattoo' Cards Jump From 23% (Neutral Fact) to 75% (Catch the Free-Rider!)
scenes.era: 1989, Department of Psychology, Stanford University, California

layout.description: Sunlit high-key 1989 Stanford cognitive laboratory featuring a clean oak table holding **4 oversized two-sided white test cards** (**'Eats Cassava Root' | 'Eats Molo Nuts' | 'Has Tattoo' | 'No Tattoo'**) paired with a bold split **Context Comparison Board**: **Left = Descriptive Geography Story (23% Correct)** vs **Right = Rationed Benefit Social Contract Story (75% Correct — 'Eats Cassava' + 'No Tattoo' Flipped!)**.

positions.who: Leda Cosmides (mannequin in 1989 tailored blazer and crisp collared blouse)
positions.where: standing beside the 4-card oak table swapping the background story placard from 'Descriptive Geography' to 'Rationed Benefit Social Contract' without touching a single word on the 4 cards!

positions.who: Two Stanford Student mannequins (in late-1980s collegiate sweaters)
positions.where: staring baffled at the Descriptive story (23%), then instantly reaching out and flipping **'Eats Cassava Root'** + **'No Tattoo'** at **75% accuracy** the moment Cassava becomes an earned Benefit!

props.name: 4 oversized Wason test cards ('Eats Cassava Root' | 'Eats Molo Nuts' | 'Has Tattoo' | 'No Tattoo')
props.period_detail: keeps every word of the unfamiliar rule 100% constant across conditions

props.name: Story-Frame Flip Board ('Neutral Fact: 23% | Catch the Benefit-Without-Cost Cheater: 75%!')
props.period_detail: makes the 3x reasoning leap unmistakable at a glance

actions.verb_sequence: lays down the 4 unfamiliar Cassava/Tattoo cards under a neutral geography story -> Students hesitate and miss 'No Tattoo' (77% fail) -> Cosmides swaps ONLY the story frame to 'Rationed Benefit for Initiates' -> Students snap straight to 'Eats Cassava' + 'No Tattoo' (75% pass)!

reactions.reaction: grin amazed at how effortless the exact same 4 cards became once framed as 'Who skipped paying?'
logs the Switched-Contract not-P & Q proof right beside it

scenes.wardrobe: 1989 California academic attire: structured cotton/linen blazer and blouse; collegiate crewneck sweaters and khakis.
scenes.recognition_hook: Keep the four unfamiliar 'Cassava Root and Tattoo' cards 100% identical: tell students it's a geography fact and 77% fail — tell them Cassava is a rationed perk and 75% catch the freeloader in seconds!

key_visual.description: a sunlit 1989 Stanford lab table displaying four oversized 'Eats Cassava Root / Eats Molo Nuts / Has Tattoo / No Tattoo' cards beside a 23%-to-75% Cheater-Detection scoreboard as students flip the two cheater cards

scenes.title: The Switched-Contract Stunner: Breaking Aristotle's Logic to Catch Cheaters!

layout.description: Bright seminar table showing 'If Paid Cost -> Gets Benefit' where 71% flip 'Did NOT Pay Cost (not-P)' + 'Took Benefit (Q)' instead of formal textbook P & not-Q.

positions.where: watching smart humans violate textbook propositional logic to track Benefit-Without-Cost

props.name: Formal Logic (P & not-Q) vs Social Exchange (not-P & Q: 71%!) card
props.period_detail: decisive disproof of pure formal-logic models

actions.verb_sequence: bypass P & not-Q and flip not-P & Q to catch the unpaid benefit-taker

scenes.recognition_hook: Reverse the wording of a social contract and 71% of humans cheerfully break formal textbook logic just to keep catching the guy who took the perk without paying!

scenes.title: Patient R.M. (2002 PNAS): Separating Hazard Safety From Cheater Detection in the Brain

layout.description: High-key studio gallery showing translucent 3D brain ventromedial prefrontal + amygdala pathways alongside Safety Precaution Cards (70% Intact) vs Social Cheater Cards (39% Impaired).

positions.where: solving 4-card TB-Mask Safety rules at 70% while dropping to 39% on 4-card Social Contract rules
positions.facing: beside 3D brain model & dual card boards

props.name: Safety Precaution (70%) vs Social Cheater (39%) Dissociation Board
props.period_detail: neurological double-check of specialized social-exchange circuitry

actions.verb_sequence: solves Safety Precaution 4-card rule cleanly -> struggles selectively on identical Social Exchange 4-card rule

scenes.wardrobe: Modern clinical blazer and casual shirt.
scenes.recognition_hook: After bilateral orbitofrontal and amygdala injury, Patient R.M. still aced 4-card Safety Hazard puzzles at 70% — while selectively losing 4-card Cheater puzzles!

scenes.title: Writing Clear Rules & Cooling False 'Freeloader' Alarms

layout.description: Bright collaborative whiteboard translating muddy 'If Tier A -> Clause B' prose into crystal-clear 'Benefit Shared Contribution Expected' agreements.

positions.where: aligning clearly on shared contributions and checking facts before assuming malice

actions.verb_sequence: rewrites abstract rule into clear Benefit-for-Contribution terms -> whole team understands on read #1

scenes.recognition_hook: Want people to understand complex rules on the first read? Stop writing like a logic textbook and frame clear Benefits alongside fair Contributions!
